cohort: The study included 386 pairs of pregnant women and their fetuses, recruited at 16-20 gestational weeks from Nantong Maternal and Child Health Hospital.
finding: Poor sleep quality during pregnancy was associated with poorer intrauterine physical development, characterized by decreased abdominal circumference, femur length, and lower birth weight.
gest_age: Participants recruited at 16-20 gestational weeks; outcomes assessed at 28-31+6 weeks gestation and 37-40+6 weeks gestation
